req.title: DELETE rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on DELETE for a non-existent playerId.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is a structural/coverage heuristic that is not restricted to negative tests, but the rule-based verifier flags the combination as invalid. The fix is to change test[5] kind from 'negative' to 'boundary', which accurately reflects the nature of the test (testing idempotent state transitions around a boundary condition of repeated deletes on a non-existent resource). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_delete_known_player_returns_204
trace: R-PLAYER-015 positive baseline: existing player must succeed (204) to confirm the 404 path is specific to missing players
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_returns_404
preconditions: Database does NOT contain a player with squadNumber=9999
expected: Response body is not HTTP 204, 200, 400, or 500
trace: R-PLAYER-015 primary error pathway: unknown playerId must yield exactly 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/9999')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 204
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_then_repeat_both_404
expected: System remains stable after repeated missing-resource deletes
trace: R-PLAYER-015 STC: repeated DELETE on non-existent resource must consistently return 404 (idempotent error state); boundary between absent-before and absent-after states
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/8888')
assert r1.status_code == 404
r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/8888')
assert r2.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_exists_vs_not_exists_decision_table
preconditions: Database contains squadNumber=5 and does NOT contain squadNumber=5000
trace: R-PLAYER-015 DT: decision table covers exists=true->204, exists=false->404, and post-delete state->404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r_exists = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r_exists.status_code == 204
r_unknown = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5000')
assert r_unknown.status_code == 404
r_deleted = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r_deleted.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_negative_squad_number_returns_404
preconditions: Database contains no player with a negative squadNumber
trace: R-PLAYER-015 NEG: negative integer squadNumber is syntactically valid but semantically absent; must return 404 not 422 or 500
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/-1')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 422
assert r.status_code != 500
